Message:
sctp: also copy sk_tsflags when copying the socket

As we are keeping timestamps on when copying the socket, we also have to
copy sk_tsflags.

This is needed since b9f40e21ef42 ("net-timestamp: move timestamp flags
out of sk_flags").
